text.title: Mathematical Expressions: Play it
text.level1-Mc1_1: The number of students in a class
text.level1-Mc2_1: The number of students plus 1 teacher
text.level1-Mc3_1: The number of students when 3 students are absent
text.level1-Mc4_1: The number of students when 2 new students join the class
text.level1-Mc5_1: The number of students divided equally into 6 groups
text.level1-Mc6_1: The number of pencils if each student has 3 pencils each
text.directions-19: Find as many matching pairs as you can.
text.directions-20: For each correct match you get 10 points added to your score.  For each incorrect match 2 points are subtracted from your score. Correct answers will reveal a picture and music.
text.directions-21: When you are ready to play, choose a level and then click Start to begin the Mathematical Expressions Match Game.
text.directions-22: Click one box then find the different box whose contents matches and click it.
